subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Separate a scatter plot by colors?

messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Separate a scatter plot by colors?
parts:
My suggestions
- don't use a different shape per site - don't include site as a legend. Too many sites. 
- make a new variable that controls the characteristic you want and use that new variable in the plotting code. 

md=read.table("C:\\data.txt")
ta=md$mod

md$sig.col <- ifelse(md$sig < .05, 2, 3)
md$sig.shape <- ifelse(md$sig < .05, 1, 19)


plot(md$grh,md$ref,main="",ylab = " ", xlab = "", 
     pch=md$sig.shape, col=md$sig.col, cex=2, 
     ylim=c(-2,12),xlim=c(-2,2))
text(md$grh,md$ref, pos=ifelse(md$sig < .05, 1, 3), labels=md$mod, cex=.6)



On Mon, Apr 24, 2017 at 6:56 AM, bic ton <bict...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi everybody,

I have a text file  (attached) for several sites: "mod" with other variables.

I use this code to do a scatter plot:

md=read.table("C:\\data.txt")
ta=md$mod
plot(md$grh,md$ref,main="",ylab = " ", xlab = "", pch=c(1:13), col=rainbow(13),cex=2, ylim=c(-2,12),xlim=c(-2,2))
legend("topright", legend = ta,pch=c(1:13), col=rainbow(13),cex=0.90)

But I need to do two things:
1- use filled symbols for sites with "sig" >0.05 and empty symbols for the sites with "sig" <0.05
2- use red color for sites with "sig" >0.05 and green color for the sites with "sig" <0.05

Any hints on this?
Thanks
